title: salvia rhodostephana
intro: Salvia rhodostephana, commonly known as Red Sage, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Salvia rhodostephana are primarily attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which can help to promote cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Salvia rhodostephana include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
